images.review: Six coordinated square face treatments and a wireframe target; the views show repeated stone courses. The contact panel is visually sparse and only the height target is labeled; use the manifest and contract for full six-face proposal data, not image measurement.

One full cube with clear margins on neutral background. The corrective iteration creates a substantially straight silhouette and keeps the face treatment inside its apparent boundary. The course seams remain illustrative, not a measured technical mesh.

rejectedIterations.reason: Stone course pieces extended beyond the intended straight cube envelope.

actionableFindings: Concept sheet illustrates surfaces but does not fully depict six numeric contact planes or all three equal target dimensions.
Corrected clean view appears flush and block-like; do not treat generated masonry detail as numerical evidence.

componentBoundary: One solid cell-full reference component appearance. Does not fulfill separate kit roles for inside/outside faces, corners, returns, caps, joints, openings, roofs, curves, or cross-kit interfaces.
